authority: Manon (Justin Addam Higgins) — sole authority; his direct AI order acts with his authority

enforcement.note: No regulator AI exists yet. This file is the policy it will obey when built. Until then, code/governance.py refuses destructive ops by default.

rules.additive_default: Generators and sweeps are additive-only by default. Dedupe resolves collisions by prefixing/renaming new records, never by replacing existing ones.
rules.audit: Every allowed removal/overwrite writes an entry to data/governance-log.jsonl with: record_id, reason, proof reference, confirmer, timestamp.
rules.immutability: Once a record/file is added to any database, it is immutable. It may be reorganized (moved, re-indexed, re-categorized) or added to (new records, new fields, new versions as separate records).
rules.no_silent_mutation: No builder, generator, regulator AI, or script may silently delete or rewrite records. All destructive operations must pass through code/governance.py::assert_mutation_allowed.
rules.removal: Removal or overwrite of a record is allowed ONLY when: (1) the record is proven wrong with evidence, AND (2) he or his direct AI order confirms the removal. Both conditions required.

visibility: NEVER rendered on any user-facing page. Machine-readable policy only.
